thesis: An exact audio source becomes a deterministic glyph thumbnail that can be opened back into bounded facets of the same object—identity, structure, text witness, origin and collection—before a human authors a path or RETURN. Thumbnail and inside remain one addressed source, not two projects.
lineage: /recovery/path-grid/ — CELL → EDGE/BY → PATH → ADDRESS → VIEW → RETURN
/law-zoo/palimpsest.html — representation as a dynamical surface, not canonical truth
implemented: up to 12 local files decode to SHA-256 source cells and immediate PREVIEW glyphs
deep AUDIO MAP refinement updates glyphs in place through the existing analyzer worker
ID3 title/artist metadata is preserved when present
click-focus plus explicit ADD/REMOVE writes a human-authored ordered path
compact URL hash shares glyph descriptors/path/note but never audio bytes
full JSON RETURN preserves exact source hashes and the projection law
synthetic demo constellation makes the public link alive without uploads
IDLE traverses focus only and never alters path/source
focused glyph now opens an INSIDE facet grid: IDENTITY / STRUCTURE / SIGNATURE / TEXT / ORIGIN / COLLECTION
Atlas share packets preserve bounded format/album/origin/collection/text-witness evidence but never audio bytes
M4A/MP4 metadata and LRC/VTT/SRT/TXT sidecar evidence may materialize into source cells
M3U/M3U8/PLS context may label a local source constellation
origin link is independently openable when present; synthetic/local-only cells do not invent one
glyph remains the compact thumbnail; focus is a reversible drill into the same source cell
boundaries: shared packet contains representation evidence, not licensed/source audio
source identity is exact hash; name/title is display metadata
IDLE is witness-only and cannot author PATH
learned embedding neighborhoods remain held until deterministic glyph recognition is tested
inside facets expose recovered/provided evidence only; no inferred album/lyrics/origin/collection
the glyph is a projection and thumbnail, never a substitute for exact source identity
shared source facets are bounded metadata/witnesses only and must not smuggle audio or full private transcripts

verification.direct_use: REQUIRED_NEXT: load 5–12 familiar source bundles, click glyph→inside, confirm recognition and that origin/text/collection facets feel like one object rather than metadata clutter.
